children: Hitting the road this season for the "Captain While You Can" Tailgate Tour, the Captain has returned to the helm and set his sights on football towns nationwide alongside a crew of First Mates including Yung Gravy, Brett Neustrom and Lucas Brody
NEW YORK, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The wait is over: football is back, and so is the Captain (yes, that guy with the epic pose). This season, Captain Morgan is hitting the road with the
"Captain While You Can" Tailgate Tour

, bringing the Captain—and his ship—to football towns across the country. At every stop, the Captain will lead the crew, rally hometown pride and spark the spontaneity that makes game day unforgettable, turning each tailgate into a celebration of the traditions and unexpected moments that make football culture uniquely local.
Experience the full interactive Multichannel News Release here:
This season, the Captain and his crew are raising a Captain & cola at stops along the way, including:
Wisconsin @ Notre Dame: Sunday, September 6 in Green Bay, WI
Iowa St @ Iowa: Saturday, September 12 in Iowa City, IA
Detroit Lions @ Buffalo Bills: Thursday, September 17 in Buffalo, NY
Houston @ Texas Tech: Saturday, September 19 in Lubbock, TX
Akron @ Central Michigan: Saturday, October 3 in Mount Pleasant, MI
Atlanta Falcons @ Tampa Bay Buccaneers: Sunday, November 1 in Tampa, FL

"Captain Morgan is bringing the Captain back IRL this football season, putting him back at the helm and on the road to lead the tailgate in football towns across the country. Football has a way of bringing everyone together — friends, families and fans who show up season after season to cheer on their teams and make a day of it. That spirit of coming together, celebrating and making the most of the moment is exactly what Captain While You Can is all about," says Hadley Schafer, SVP at Diageo.
Speaking of bringing people together, the Captain has assembled a crew of First Mates ready to make their mark on football country: rapper, songwriter and Badger alum
Yung Gravy
; Iowa native, content creator and actor
Brett Neustrom
; and internet personality and Michigan alum
Lucas Brody

. With three First Mates, a mapped out season taking over football hotbeds and plenty of personality to go around, this crew will bring the Captain's signature spirit to game days from the heartland to the South and all the way up to Buffalo. At each stop, fans can expect the unexpected — from outrageous challenges and surprise giveaways to custom Captain Morgan gear and plenty of opportunities to ditch the ordinary, rally the crew and turn game day into a legendary one.
"Football, tailgates and the Captain? That's a pretty elite lineup. We're bringing the energy, rallying the crew, and I'm personally repping the Badgers," says Yung Gravy.

And the Captain's football fandom doesn't stop at the tailgate. For the second year, Captain Morgan is teaming up with Pirate Worldwide for a limited-edition football merch collaboration, featuring three custom drops in collaboration with teams along the stop of this season's tailgate tour. The drops will give fans a new way to rep their crew and bring a little Captain Morgan spirit to game day.

From discovering an unexpected tailgate takeover to unlocking exclusive gear or finding yourself at the center of an unforgettable game day moment, Captain Morgan is reminding fans that the best memories aren't always planned — they're seized. Follow @CaptainMorganUSA and #CaptainWhileYouCan to see where the Captain lands next and catch the fun when it hits your next tailgate.
